about: Quotes from Kewaunee's PNC Loan Agreement (8-K Ex 10.1, 2024-11-01), each verbatim after brief-reader.md section 6 normalization and under 15 words, with the section that contains it. Extracted by Cayden's agent on 2026-10-25 from the SEC copy; Eric's E3 file replaces this one if it differs. The scripted Brief Reader uses them when the agreement's normalized SHA-256 is listed below.
